description: Defines the LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams class, a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering leave comment searches, extending date range filter parameters, with configurable sorting by creation date.

classes.name: LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters for leave comments, including leave ID and sorting options, extending date range filtering capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'leaveComment.createdAt'.

methods.name: getLeaveId
methods.description: Returns the leave ID used as a filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLeaveId
methods.description: Sets the leave ID filter parameter.
